MUS.note: Adopted AI standards are not a rule on AI harms.
Adopted AI standards are not AI built in the country.

facts.fact: The Mauritius Standards Bureau lists ISO/IEC 22989:2022, 23894:2023, 42001:2023, 38507:2022 and 27403:2024 as Mauritian Standards published under Government Notice 119 of 25 January 2025.

The Mauritius Standards Bureau lists ISO/IEC 22989, 23894, 42001, 38507 and 27403 on information technology and cybersecurity as new Mauritian Standards published under Government Notice 119 of 25 January 2025.
